result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now collects only active contributors. I made no new tests. The `Landscape*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but they may not exercise this path.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/.../landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. Unmatched contributors are added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped. Configured teams are untouched.

I didn't change `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`. It already returns true for a blank latest-commit date, so those contributors still land in the remainder.
